data.body: Backfill note from epic 3e36-a1b8-4671-450c / story 9b61-6b8e-2ec1-45d4 (obligation infrastructure): the 4 DDs on this story marked "deferred to rollout-time operator execution" are subsumed by epic 3e36-a1b8-4671-450c story 4 (live phased rollout), which IS the validation work. No duplicate obligation tickets are being created here. Going forward, dso:completion-verifier auto-creates obligation tickets when DDs match the deferred-evidence regex — see plugins/dso/docs/contracts/obligation-ticket-schema.md.
